test_title: PYST 6: SSC JE CE- General Intelligence (Held On 10 Oct 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Cricket commentators – Boycott, Sidhu, Sunny, Shastri, and Harsha along with two guest speakers Kapil and Srikanth – have to sit in a row to get a photograph taken. Harsha and Shastri being the youngest among the group sit on either side. Since Kapil and Srikanth are guest speakers they sit together. But Kapil and Sunny do not get along with each other and should be seated with at least 2 persons between them. Sidhu being the victim of all their leg-pulling is upset and sits with one of the young commentators. Among the following, who could be seated at the centre?
solution:
As per the given information,

1) Harsha and Shastri being the youngest among the group sit on either side.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7327be3d2a5b60faa1b8acfdd62c693194d26d0d3e7e7afd4a2f3e5f7417c2f5.png] 

2) Sidhu being the victim of all their leg-pulling is upset and sits with one of the young commentators.

**Case: 1**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4279657e0951854fb27767ac5094451cccdd3a6b804bdf6feb4bcae8739c4a8.png] 

**Case: 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59fcfd25658b69cde6d1ce1d01558f6a1ce73305a95d7ec57c05b0cd9ed30b57.png] 

3) But Kapil and Sunny do not get along with each other and should be seated with at least 2 persons between them.

Case: 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f92ef489fafe17f5d317b8cd491f7bf4a95f0825e6087cf4f3ae383d2ee8c003.png] 

Case: 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/115fbf19a23a54b3cb1649906d1092c4c2902a75557b16d1e424cb8cffadaac6.png] 

Since Kapil and Srikanth are guest speakers they sit together. Then the possibility of sitting at the centre is only for two commentators: Srikanth and Boycott. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****Boycott"**.
